result.summary: Deprecates the unused watch-only named options across several wallet RPCs (`fundrawtransaction`, `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, `send`, `sendall`, and `simulaterawtransaction`). Passing `includeWatching`, `include_watching`, or `include_watchonly` now raises an `RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED` error unless `-deprecatedrpc=watchonly` is configured. The PR also includes two minor cleanups removing an obsolete test flag and fixing a documentation typo.
result.problem: Legacy watch-only parameters remain accepted in multiple wallet RPCs despite having functioned as no-ops since commit 1337c72198a7d32935431d64e9e58c12f9003abc. Callers continue to provide inert options without being informed of their upcoming removal.
evidence: PR description: "Since 'leet' commit 1337c72198a7d32935431d64e9e58c12f9003abc, the options are deprecated no-ops, so it seems time to properly start a deprecation cycle for them."
result.scope_notes: Includes two minor unrelated cleanups: removing a stale `-deprecatedrpc=removeprunedfunds` setting from a functional test and fixing a typo in `doc/managing-wallets.md`.
result.changed_since_previous: Added two commits: a doc typo fix in doc/managing-wallets.md and the removal of a stale `-deprecatedrpc=removeprunedfunds` flag from wallet_importprunedfunds.py.
result.card: This PR starts the deprecation cycle for unused watch-only named options in wallet RPCs, including fundrawtransaction, walletcreatefundedpsbt, send, sendall, and simulaterawtransaction. Passing includeWatching, include_watching, or include_watchonly now raises an RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED error unless the node is started with -deprecatedrpc=watchonly. The author points out that these arguments have functioned as dead no-ops since commit 1337c72198a7d32935431d64e9e58c12f9003abc.

risk.why: RPC clients passing the deprecated watch-only parameters without -deprecatedrpc=watchonly will fail with an RPC_METHOD_DEPRECATED error.
